vendor_and_service: Payment processor and gateway (SYS-02): store encryption service, hosted fields and SDK, tokens, virtual terminal, merchant portal
tier_rationale: Processes all card data; TPSP for PCI DSS 12.8; supports BP-01, BP-02, BP-03
assurance_required: Current PCI DSS service provider AOC (ROC by a QSA) yearly; SOC 2 Type 2 if offered; responsibility matrix
report_type_and_period: PCI DSS service provider AOC dated 2026-03-20; SOC 1 Type 2 (financial reporting) for 2025
scope_categories_or_pci_services: Payment processing, tokenization, hosted payment fields, virtual terminal; in-store encryption service listed as not a PCI-validated P2PE solution
opinion_or_aoc_status: AOC: compliant with all applicable requirements
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Merchant responsibilities: protect checkout pages that host the fields (6.4.3, 11.6.1), restrict virtual terminal users, inspect PIN pads (9.5). Company gaps: POAM-013, POAM-017, POAM-007
availability_vs_bia: Authorization service availability commitment 99.95%; offline mode covers short outages (P05 BP-01)
incident_notification_terms: Merchant agreement: processor notifies of suspected compromise without unreasonable delay (no hour count)
follow_up: Ask for the P2PE solution listing for the 2027 terminal refresh; add a 72-hour breach notice term at renewal
reviewer_and_date: Privacy and Compliance Manager and Security Manager, 2026-08-27

tier_rationale: Hosts the checkout pages, about 52,000 customer accounts, and order data; TPSP; supports BP-03 and BP-04
assurance_required: SOC 2 Type 2 (Security, Availability) and PCI DSS service provider AOC yearly, plus bridge letter
report_type_and_period: SOC 2 Type 2, 12 months ending 2026-03-31; PCI DSS service provider AOC dated 2026-04-15
scope_categories_or_pci_services: Security; Availability. AOC covers the platform, hosting, web application firewall (6.4.1, 6.4.2)
exceptions_noted: 1 exception: 2 of 40 sampled platform changes lacked documented approval; remediated
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer must manage admin accounts and MFA, the checkout theme, installed apps, and all scripts on its pages (6.4.3, 11.6.1). Company gaps: agency accounts without MFA (POAM-003); scripts (POAM-013)
availability_vs_bia: 99.9% monthly uptime; RTO 4 hours stated; meets BP-03 RTO of 4 hours
incident_notification_terms: Contract: notify within 72 hours of confirming a security incident affecting customer data

vendor_and_service: POS vendor: registers, store server software, POS head-office application management
tier_rationale: Standing access to the CDE (store servers, POS head office); TPSP; supports BP-01
assurance_required: PCI DSS service provider AOC and SOC 2 Type 2 yearly
report_type_and_period: SOC 2 Type 1 as of 2025-12-31 (design only); PCI DSS service provider AOC expired 2026-02-28
scope_categories_or_pci_services: Security (Type 1). Expired AOC covered remote support and software maintenance
subservice_organizations: Remote support tool provider carved out
exceptions_noted: None tested (Type 1 does not test operation)
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Vendor expects the customer to approve remote sessions and manage store accounts. Company gaps: shared vendor accounts and standing access (POAM-002, POAM-017); vendor modem (POAM-020)
availability_vs_bia: No recovery commitment for the head-office application
follow_up: Current AOC by 2026-10-31 or treat the vendor's services as assessed in the company's own SAQ D; Type 2 report at the next cycle; 72-hour notice, 30-day critical patch, and no-unapproved-connection terms
reviewer_and_date: Security Manager and Privacy and Compliance Manager, 2026-08-28

tier_rationale: Hosts the POS head-office application (CDE), loyalty and CDP, warehouse, and portal
assurance_required: SOC 2 Type 2 and PCI DSS service provider AOC yearly
report_type_and_period: SOC 2 Type 2, 12 months ending 2026-03-31; PCI DSS AOC dated 2026-05
scope_categories_or_pci_services: Security; Availability; Confidentiality. AOC covers the infrastructure services in use
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer configures identity, network, encryption keys, logging, and backups (P04). Company gaps: restore testing (POAM-008); logging of the head-office application (POAM-005)

tier_rationale: Authentication for all workforce cloud and SaaS access
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer configures MFA, conditional access, and administrator roles. Company gap: phishing-resistant MFA for administrators (P01 R-009)
availability_vs_bia: 99.99% monthly uptime commitment; no RTO stated
incident_notification_terms: Security incident notice per terms of service

vendor_and_service: Managed security service provider (MSSP; SYS-09 operator)
tier_rationale: Receives security logs, runs EDR response on store servers (CDE); supports detection for every process
assurance_required: SOC 2 Type 2 (Security) and PCI DSS AOC if it has CDE access, yearly
report_type_and_period: SOC 2 Type 2, 12 months ending 2026-06-30; PCI DSS service provider AOC dated 2026-07-10
scope_categories_or_pci_services: Security. AOC covers managed detection and response
exceptions_noted: 1 exception: high-severity escalation missed the 30-minute target in 2 of 40 samples; staffing added
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer must define log sources, maintain contacts, and approve containment. Company gap: CDE log sources missing (POAM-005)
availability_vs_bia: Not a recovery provider; its own continuity plan tested yearly
incident_notification_terms: Contract: call within 30 minutes on high severity
follow_up: Request the SIEM platform provider's SOC 2; track the escalation target monthly

vendor_and_service: Pricing and personalized offers engine vendor (SYS-12, AI-001)
tier_rationale: Receives purchase history for about 148,000 members; runs offers for the supplier service (BP-09, BP-10); a subservice organization for the SOC 2 scope
assurance_required: SOC 2 Type 2 yearly; data use, no-training, deletion, and incident terms
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer controls campaign setup, price bounds, and data sent. Company gaps: pseudonymous IDs, campaign second check, fairness tests (P10; P09 PI1.2)
availability_vs_bia: No availability commitment; offers fall back to standard discounts (P05 BP-09)
incident_notification_terms: Contract silent on incident notice and data use
follow_up: Contract amendment with data use, no-training, deletion, 72-hour notice, and Availability in the next report (POAM-023)

tier_rationale: Item and price files, purchasing, finance; supports BP-05, BP-07, BP-13, BP-14
assurance_required: SOC 2 Type 2 yearly with bridge letter
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer manages user access and approval workflows (for example bank detail changes). Company gap: call-back verification (P01 R-020)
availability_vs_bia: Stated RTO 24 hours; BP-05 needs 12 hours: **does not meet the BIA** (P05 finding 3)
follow_up: Recovery term at the 2027 renewal; daily price file export (P01 R-016)

tier_rationale: Manages store firewalls and routing that protect the CDE; TPSP
assurance_required: PCI DSS service provider AOC and SOC 2 Type 2 yearly
report_type_and_period: SOC 2 Type 2, 12 months ending 2025-12-31; PCI DSS service provider AOC expired 2026-01-31
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer approves rule changes and reviews rule sets every 6 months. Company gap: data flow diagrams (P03 G-002)
availability_vs_bia: Managed failover to cellular at stores
incident_notification_terms: Contract: notify within 24 hours of a security incident affecting the customer

tier_rationale: Can publish checkout tags (affects card data security, so a TPSP for 12.8) and receives member-level exports
assurance_required: PCI DSS responsibility acknowledgment and security questionnaire; SOC 2 not expected from a 2-person agency; contract terms
exceptions_noted: Questionnaire: no MFA on the agency's own email; shared laptop
cuecs_and_company_mapping: None defined. Company actions: remove checkout publishing rights, content-only role, governed transfers (POAM-003, POAM-013, POAM-018)
follow_up: New contract with PCI DSS responsibility acknowledgment, security, use, deletion, and 72-hour notice terms; remove checkout publishing (STD-10)
